top_signals.title: Iraq Struggles to Sell Oil From Basra After Hiking Its Prices
top_signals.summary: Iraq is struggling to find buyers to collect its crude from inside the Persian Gulf this month after sharply raising the price of its barrels, a development that could jeopardize a pickkup in the nation’s oil flows.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.
